items.name: The Oak-Smoked Old Fashioned
items.description: Bourbon aged in charred American oak, smoked applewood bitters, demerara reduction, expressed orange oils, presented under a smoking cloche.
items.pairing: Pairs exquisitely with Tawa Chicken Tartlets or Truffle Galouti

items.name: Baroak Botanical Gin & Tonic
items.description: Artisanal Indian craft gin infused with dried hibiscus, wild rosemary, cracked pink peppercorn, artisanal elderflower tonic, clear ice sphere.
items.pairing: Pairs perfectly with Burrata & Truffle Pesto Pizza

items.name: Jamun & Smoked Rosemary Sour
items.description: Vodka infused with seasonal wild black plums (jamun), fresh lime cordial, aquafaba froth, torched rosemary sprig, Himalayan black salt rim.
items.pairing: Complements Kasundi Fish Tikka & Spicy Dim Sum

items.name: Kaffir Lime & Chili Mezcalita
items.description: Espadín Mezcal, fresh pressed kaffir lime, bird's eye chili agave syrup, fresh yuzu, smoked volcanic salt rim.
items.pairing: Great with Crispy Pork Belly Bao & Spiced Tandoori Prawns

items.name: Signature Tawa Chicken Tartlets
items.description: Slow-braised shredded tawa chicken tossed in caramelized shallots and aromatic roasted cumin, encased in crisp buttery sablé shells, garnished with pickled radish and micro-cilantro.
items.pairing: Pairs with Oak-Smoked Old Fashioned

items.name: Truffle Mushroom Galouti on Sheermal
items.description: Melt-in-mouth smoked portobello and button mushroom patties infused with 16 royal spices, served on warm saffron-brushed mini sheermal breads with mint emulsion.
items.pairing: Pairs with Botanical Gin & Tonic

items.name: Kasundi Mustard Charred Fish Tikka
items.description: Fresh river sole steeped in pungent Bengal kasundi mustard, crushed yellow mustard seeds, lemon oil, and hung curd, charcoal-blistered to flaky perfection.
items.pairing: Pairs with Jamun & Smoked Rosemary Sour

items.name: Crispy Honey Chili Lotus Stem & Edamame
items.description: Thin lotus root rounds wok-tossed with green edamame beans in a sticky ginger chili glaze, toasted sesame, and spring onions.
items.pairing: Pairs with Chilled Craft Witbier or Gin Tonic

items.name: Burrata, Truffle Pesto & San Marzano
items.description: Stone-baked sourdough crust topped with San Marzano DOP tomato sauce, whole fresh Pugliese burrata ball, basil walnut pesto, and black truffle drizzle.
items.pairing: Pairs with Baroak Botanical Gin & Tonic

items.name: Smoked Chicken, Caramelized Fig & Gorgonzola
items.description: Oak-smoked shredded chicken breast, sweet balsamic caramelized figs, creamy Italian gorgonzola, fresh fior di latte mozzarella, and wild arugula.
items.pairing: Pairs with Smoked Bourbon Manhattan

items.name: Piccante Pepperoni & Hot Calabrian Honey
items.description: Imported artisanal pork pepperoni, spicy salami, roasted red peppers, buffalo mozzarella, and a drizzle of hot chili-infused honey.
items.pairing: Pairs with Craft IPA or Kaffir Lime Mezcalita

items.name: Wild Truffle Mushroom Crystal Dumplings
items.description: Translucent handmade tapioca skin stuffed with shiitake, porcini, water chestnuts, and fragrant white truffle essence, served with chili crisps.
items.pairing: Pairs with Jasmine Green Tea or Botanical G&T

items.name: Spicy Prawn & Tobiko Har Gow
items.description: Succulent ocean prawns with spring bamboo shoots wrapped in pleated translucent skin, crowned with golden flying fish roe (tobiko).
items.pairing: Pairs with Jamun Rosemary Sour

items.name: Charred Glazed Pork Belly Bao Buns
items.description: Fluffy steamed lotus leaf baos filled with twice-cooked spiced pork belly, crushed peanuts, cucumber ribbons, and hoisin plum glaze.
items.pairing: Pairs with Oak-Smoked Old Fashioned

items.name: Slow-Braised Lamb Shank Rogan Josh
items.description: 8-hour slow braised prime New Zealand lamb shank in a rich aromatic Kashmiri gravy scented with ratanjot, fennel, and dried ginger. Served with garlic rosemary naan.
items.pairing: Pairs with Oak Smoked Old Fashioned

items.name: Smoked Butter Chicken Ravioli
items.description: Handmade egg pasta parcels stuffed with charcoal-pulled tandoori chicken, floating in a velvety fenugreek and butter makhani emulsion, topped with parmesan crisp.
items.pairing: Pairs with Full-Bodied Red Wine or Botanical G&T

items.name: Dal Baroak (24-Hour Slow Cooked)
items.description: Whole black urad lentils slow-simmered overnight over smouldering charcoal embers with vine tomatoes, churned white butter, and aromatic dried fenugreek.
items.pairing: Best enjoyed with Chur Chur Garlic Naan

items.name: Paneer Roulade in Zafrani Makhani
items.description: Silken cottage cheese sheets rolled with dry fruit, khoya, and crushed pistachios, gently poached in a rich saffron-scented cashew tomato gravy.
items.pairing: Pairs with Truffle Butter Naan

items.name: Old Monk Dark Chocolate Fondant
items.description: Warm Belgian 70% dark chocolate lava cake with a molten core infused with aged dark rum, served with Madagascar vanilla bean gelato and cocoa crumble.
items.pairing: Pairs with Espresso Martini or Oak Smoked Bourbon

items.name: Baked Gulab Jamun & Cardamom Cheesecake
items.description: Creamy New York style baked cheesecake layered with warm saffron-syrup soaked mini gulab jamuns on a spiced cardamom biscuit crust, garnished with edible gold leaf.
items.pairing: Pairs with Masala Chai Latte or Dessert Wine

items.name: Saffron & Rose Petal Panna Cotta
items.description: Velvety Italian cooked cream scented with Kashmiri saffron strands and wild rosewater, finished with a tart pomegranate reduction and candied rose petals.
items.pairing: Pairs with Botanical Gin Sundowner
